description: An introduction to plane geometry covering points, lines, rays and segments, types of angles and how to measure and name them, angle relationships (complementary, supplementary, on a straight line, at a point, vertically opposite), parallel lines cut by a transversal, and the properties of triangles and quadrilaterals.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following is an angle that measures exactly 90 degrees?
mcq.explanation: An angle of exactly 90 degrees is called a right angle. It is often marked with a small square at the vertex.

mcq.questionText: An angle that is greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees is called:
mcq.explanation: An obtuse angle is larger than a right angle (90 degrees) but smaller than a straight angle (180 degrees).

mcq.questionText: What is the complement of an angle of 35 degrees?
mcq.explanation: Complementary angles add up to 90 degrees, so the complement is 90 - 35 = 55 degrees.

mcq.questionText: What is the supplement of an angle of 120 degrees?
mcq.explanation: Supplementary angles add up to 180 degrees, so the supplement is 180 - 120 = 60 degrees.

mcq.questionText: Two angles lie on a straight line. If one angle is 110 degrees, what is the other angle?
mcq.explanation: Angles on a straight line add up to 180 degrees, so the other angle is 180 - 110 = 70 degrees.

mcq.questionText: The angles at a point add up to how many degrees?
mcq.explanation: The angles around a single point make a complete turn, which is 360 degrees.

mcq.questionText: Two straight lines intersect. If one of the angles formed is 65 degrees, what is the size of the angle vertically opposite to it?
mcq.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are equal, so the angle opposite the 65 degree angle is also 65 degrees.

mcq.questionText: A triangle has angles of 50 degrees and 60 degrees. What is the size of the third angle?
mcq.explanation: The angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees, so the third angle is 180 - 50 - 60 = 70 degrees.

mcq.questionText: Which type of triangle has all three sides equal and all three angles equal to 60 degrees?
mcq.explanation: An equilateral triangle has three equal sides and three equal angles, each measuring 60 degrees.

mcq.questionText: When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, corresponding angles are:
mcq.explanation: When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, corresponding angles (in matching positions) are equal.

mcq.questionText: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One co-interior (allied) angle is 105 degrees. What is the other co-interior angle?
mcq.explanation: Co-interior (allied) angles between parallel lines are supplementary, adding to 180 degrees, so the other is 180 - 105 = 75 degrees.

mcq.questionText: Which of the following quadrilaterals has all four sides equal and all four angles equal to 90 degrees?
mcq.explanation: A square has four equal sides and four right angles. A rhombus has equal sides but not always right angles, and a rectangle has right angles but not always equal sides.

mcq.questionText: What do you call a part of a line that has one fixed starting point and extends without end in one direction?
mcq.explanation: A ray has one endpoint and extends infinitely in one direction. A line segment has two endpoints, and a line extends in both directions.

mcq.questionText: In an isosceles triangle the two base angles are equal. If the vertex angle is 40 degrees, what is the size of each base angle?
mcq.explanation: The angles add to 180 degrees. The two equal base angles share 180 - 40 = 140 degrees, so each is 140 / 2 = 70 degrees.

mcq.questionText: An angle measures 220 degrees. What type of angle is it?
mcq.explanation: A reflex angle is greater than 180 degrees but less than 360 degrees. Since 220 degrees lies in this range, it is a reflex angle.

fib.questionText: An angle that measures less than 90 degrees is called an ____ angle.
fib.explanation: An acute angle is any angle greater than 0 degrees but less than 90 degrees.

fib.questionText: Two angles whose measures add up to 90 degrees are called ____ angles.
fib.explanation: Complementary angles have a total measure of 90 degrees.

fib.questionText: Two angles whose measures add up to 180 degrees are called ____ angles.
fib.explanation: Supplementary angles have a total measure of 180 degrees.

fib.questionText: The sum of the interior angles of any triangle is ____ degrees.
fib.explanation: The three interior angles of any triangle always add up to 180 degrees.

fib.questionText: The instrument used to measure the size of an angle in degrees is called a ____.
fib.explanation: A protractor is a semicircular instrument marked from 0 to 180 degrees used to measure and draw angles.

fib.questionText: When two lines cross each other, the angles opposite each other at the point of intersection are called ____ angles.
fib.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are formed when two straight lines intersect, and they are always equal.

fib.questionText: A line that crosses two or more other lines is called a ____.
fib.explanation: A transversal is a line that intersects two or more lines at distinct points, forming corresponding, alternate and co-interior angles.

fib.questionText: A triangle in which all three sides have different lengths is called a ____ triangle.
fib.explanation: A scalene triangle has all three sides of different lengths and all three angles different.

fib.questionText: A quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides is called a ____.
fib.explanation: A trapezium is a quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides.

fib.questionText: The sum of the interior angles of any quadrilateral is ____ degrees.
fib.explanation: A quadrilateral can be divided into two triangles, so its interior angles add up to 2 x 180 = 360 degrees.

tf.questionText: A straight angle measures exactly 180 degrees.
tf.explanation: A straight angle forms a straight line and measures 180 degrees.

tf.questionText: A line segment has two endpoints.
tf.explanation: A line segment is a part of a line bounded by two distinct endpoints and has a fixed length.

tf.questionText: Vertically opposite angles are always supplementary.
tf.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are always equal, not supplementary. Only when they are right angles do they also happen to add to 180 degrees.

tf.questionText: The complement of 60 degrees is 30 degrees.
tf.explanation: Complementary angles add to 90 degrees, and 90 - 60 = 30 degrees.

tf.questionText: A reflex angle is smaller than a right angle.
tf.explanation: A reflex angle is greater than 180 degrees, which is much larger than a right angle of 90 degrees.

tf.questionText: When a transversal cuts two parallel lines, alternate angles are equal.
tf.explanation: Alternate angles (the Z-shaped pair) formed between two parallel lines and a transversal are equal.

tf.questionText: A right-angled triangle has one angle equal to 90 degrees.
tf.explanation: A right-angled triangle is defined by having exactly one right angle of 90 degrees.

tf.questionText: All the sides of a rhombus are equal in length.
tf.explanation: A rhombus is a quadrilateral with all four sides equal, though its angles are not necessarily 90 degrees.

tf.questionText: The angles around a point add up to 180 degrees.
tf.explanation: Angles at a point make a complete turn and add up to 360 degrees, not 180 degrees.

tf.questionText: A triangle can have two right angles.
tf.explanation: Two right angles already total 180 degrees, leaving nothing for the third angle, so a triangle can have at most one right angle.

summary.correctAnswer: Acute < 90, right = 90, obtuse between 90 and 180, straight = 180, reflex between 180 and 360 degrees.
summary.explanation: Angles are classified by how many degrees they measure, from acute (smallest) to reflex (largest below a full turn).

summary.correctAnswer: Two angles that add up to 90 degrees.
summary.explanation: If angle A and angle B are complementary, then A + B = 90 degrees.

summary.correctAnswer: Two angles that add up to 180 degrees.
summary.explanation: If angle A and angle B are supplementary, then A + B = 180 degrees.

summary.correctAnswer: Angles on a straight line add up to 180 degrees.
summary.explanation: Any angles formed on one side of a straight line at a point sum to 180 degrees.

summary.correctAnswer: Angles around a point add up to 360 degrees.
summary.explanation: All angles meeting at a single point form a complete turn of 360 degrees.

summary.correctAnswer: When two lines cross, vertically opposite angles are equal.
summary.explanation: The pairs of angles opposite each other at the intersection of two straight lines are always equal.

summary.questionText: Parallel lines cut by a transversal.
summary.correctAnswer: Corresponding angles are equal, alternate angles are equal, and co-interior angles add to 180 degrees.
summary.explanation: These three angle relationships arise when a transversal crosses two parallel lines.

summary.correctAnswer: The three interior angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.
summary.explanation: This holds for every triangle, whatever its shape or size.

summary.correctAnswer: Equilateral (all sides equal), isosceles (two sides equal), scalene (no sides equal); also right-angled, acute and obtuse by angle.
summary.explanation: Triangles are named by their sides or by their largest angle.

summary.correctAnswer: The four interior angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360 degrees.
summary.explanation: A quadrilateral splits into two triangles, so its angles total 2 x 180 = 360 degrees.

hoq.questionText: Two angles are supplementary. The larger angle is 30 degrees more than twice the smaller angle. What is the size of the smaller angle?
hoq.explanation: Let the smaller angle be x. Then x + (2x + 30) = 180, so 3x + 30 = 180 and 3x = 150, giving x = 50 degrees.

hoq.questionText: In a triangle, the second angle is twice the first, and the third angle is 30 degrees more than the first. What is the size of the first angle?
hoq.explanation: Let the first angle be x. Then x + 2x + (x + 30) = 180, so 4x + 30 = 180 and 4x = 150, giving x = 37.5 degrees.

hoq.questionText: A transversal crosses two parallel lines. One angle is (3x + 10) degrees and its co-interior angle on the same side is (2x + 20) degrees. Find the value of x.
hoq.explanation: Co-interior angles between parallel lines add to 180 degrees: (3x + 10) + (2x + 20) = 180, so 5x + 30 = 180 and 5x = 150, giving x = 30.
